name: bento-steps
title: Bento steps
description: A how-it-works section: numbered steps in Tiles joined by a connector line, with done, now and up next read out in words.

props.name: intro
props.description: A short line under the heading.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A small mono label above the heading.

props.name: current
props.description: The index (from 0) of the step that is happening now. Steps before it are done. Leave it out to show no progress.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible and spoken string that is not content.

a11y.text: A section named by its h2 with an ordered list; the current step has aria-current="step". Each step has an h3 and a screen-reader-only "Step" before the number; when current is set, the state is said in words (Done, Now, and a screen-reader-only Up next). Checks and dots are aria-hidden, and the connecting line is a CSS pseudo-element with no content.
